title: Noun cases: вікно (window)
summary: A neuter noun through all 7 cases. Its stress moves: вікна́ is genitive singular, ві́кна is plural, and a slip shows them alike.

loc.sg.note: In the locative after на or у, it is вікні́. Dictionaries also list вікну́, which the spelling rules allow for nouns like this only after по.
